question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Shortened form of a word
solution:
The correct answer is **Abbreviation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abbreviation: **a short form of a word or phrase.

 
 
• **Example: ***USA is the commonly used abbreviation for the United States of America.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Punctuation: **the marks used for dividing writing into sentences and phrases.
 
• **Connotation: **an idea expressed by a word in addition to its main meaning.
 
• **Allocation: **the act or process of giving out parts of a whole.
